role: Static GL plumbing: hands out GL display lists and tracks them for deletion, and allocates direct NIO byte/int/float buffers for vertex and matrix data.
scope_reason: Display lists and NIO buffers are GL-call-stream machinery; the C engine keeps world meshes in flat int arrays and never emits display lists (SPEC 'Java, then C, then the GPU': the GL call stream is not reproduced).

members.name: generateDisplayLists
members.note: no GL display lists in the C engine

members.name: createDirectByteBuffer
members.note: the C engine's Tessellator mirror (rb_tess) is a plain int array

notes: Users in oracle/src (RenderGlobal, ClippingHelperImpl, Tessellator, Minecraft's shutdown) are all GL-call-stream paths the C engine replaces with its own flat buffers.
